name: Steel Tempest
description: An automatic close-range steel ring.

branches.name: Razor Halo
branches.description: Echo the ring after 0.3 seconds for 65% damage.

branches.name: Storm Eye
branches.description: The ring also applies Bleed.

branches.name: Advancing Storm
branches.description: Send a second half-strength ring into the nearest crowd.

synergy.name: Storm Conductor
synergy.description: Steel Tempest prepares surviving enemies for 6 seconds; the partner's hit chains bonus strikes through nearby enemies. Trigger with Ninja attacks or abilities.

name: Heavenfall
description: Strike the densest nearby group after a warning; apply Bleed.

branches.name: Starfall
branches.description: Strike up to three separate groups.

branches.name: Aftershock
branches.description: Each strike echoes at half damage after 0.4 seconds.

branches.name: Seeking Star
branches.description: The warning follows its selected enemy until impact.

synergy.name: Fallen Constellation
synergy.description: Heavenfall prepares surviving enemies for 6 seconds; the partner's hit calls down two delayed follow-up strikes. Trigger with Ninja attacks or abilities.

name: Night Thread
description: Chain between three enemies, prioritizing Bleed and poisoning bleeding targets.

branches.name: Black Web
branches.description: Leave a delayed half-damage burst at each hit.

branches.name: Venom Thread
branches.description: Every thread hit applies Poison, even without Bleed.

branches.name: Cross Stitch
branches.description: Connecting threads also cut enemies between their endpoints for 40% damage.

synergy.name: Sever the Thread
synergy.description: Night Thread prepares surviving enemies for 6 seconds; the partner's hit chains bonus strikes through nearby enemies. Trigger with Samurai attacks or abilities.

name: Venom Garden
description: Plant a wide field for eight slow pulses and Poison. Samurai melee detonates its remaining damage.

branches.name: Withering Garden
branches.description: Eleven pulses and a final burst; included in Samurai detonation.

branches.name: Wandering Garden
branches.description: Plant the field at Ninja; it follows him while he is active, then stays where he left it.

branches.name: Briar Garden
branches.description: Pulses push enemies outward, making the field a space-clearing tool.

synergy.name: Plague Harvest
synergy.description: Venom Garden prepares surviving enemies for 6 seconds; the partner's hit triggers a status-spreading burst. Trigger with Samurai attacks or abilities.

name: Blade Wave
description: Basic melee attacks launch the existing traveling blade wave.

branches.name: Returning Blade
branches.description: Waves return for another hit pass.

branches.name: Crossing Blades
branches.description: Every third swing launches three crossing waves.

branches.name: Splinter Wave
branches.description: The first enemy hit on each wave pass sheds a small 30%-damage Bleed burst.

synergy.name: Venom Edge
synergy.description: Blade Wave prepares surviving enemies for 6 seconds; the partner's hit triggers a status-spreading burst. Trigger with Ninja attacks or abilities.

name: Crescent Reaper
description: A crescent travels through the crowd, hitting each enemy once per pass.

branches.name: Reaping Return
branches.description: The crescent retraces its path for a second hit pass.

branches.name: Twin Crescents
branches.description: Send an additional crescent angled 30 degrees to the side.

branches.name: Crimson Crescent
branches.description: Each hit applies Bleed.

synergy.name: Reaper's Invitation
synergy.description: Crescent Reaper prepares surviving enemies for 6 seconds; the partner's hit pulls nearby enemies toward the victim and damages them. Trigger with Ninja attacks or abilities.

name: Iron Orbit
description: Three blades circle Samurai for four seconds, cutting enemies along their paths.

branches.name: Counter Orbit
branches.description: Add a blade orbiting in the opposite direction.

branches.name: Satellite Blades
branches.description: Add a second outer orbit.

branches.name: Orbit Shrapnel
branches.description: Orbiting blades apply Bleed.

synergy.name: Orbit Relay
synergy.description: Iron Orbit prepares surviving enemies for 6 seconds; the partner's hit deals a bonus strike and reduces this family's remaining cooldown by one second. Trigger with Ninja attacks or abilities.

name: Fault Line
description: Three delayed eruptions tear a line through the crowd.

branches.name: Cross Fault
branches.description: Add a perpendicular fault line.

branches.name: Rolling Aftershock
branches.description: Eruptions repeat at half damage.

branches.name: Rupture Lift
branches.description: Eruptions push enemies away from their centers.

synergy.name: Fault Detonator
synergy.description: Fault Line prepares surviving enemies for 6 seconds; the partner's hit calls down two delayed follow-up strikes. Trigger with Ninja attacks or abilities.

name: War Banner
description: Plant a banner in a crowd. Four pulses damage and mark survivors for Ninja.

branches.name: Marching Banner
branches.description: Plant at Samurai and follow him while active.

branches.name: Rallying Banner
branches.description: The banner also pulses at a second nearby enemy position.

branches.name: Banner of Thorns
branches.description: Banner pulses also apply Bleed.

synergy.name: Rallying Shadows
synergy.description: War Banner prepares surviving enemies for 6 seconds; the partner's hit deals a bonus strike and reduces this family's remaining cooldown by one second. Trigger with Ninja attacks or abilities.

name: Thousand Cuts
description: Focus six rapid cuts on one enemy; its death ends the flurry.

branches.name: Passing Sentence
branches.description: Retarget a nearby enemy if the victim dies.

branches.name: Shared Sentence
branches.description: Each cut splashes nearby enemies for half damage.

branches.name: Open Wounds
branches.description: Cuts apply Bleed.

synergy.name: Execution Window
synergy.description: Thousand Cuts prepares surviving enemies for 6 seconds; the partner's hit triggers a heavy single-target follow-up. Trigger with Ninja attacks or abilities.

name: Spirit Lance
description: Pierce a long, narrow line through enemies.

branches.name: Crossed Lances
branches.description: Fire two additional lances at side angles.

branches.name: Rebounding Lance
branches.description: Repeat the line after a short delay at half damage.

branches.name: Spectral Brand
branches.description: Mark enemies hit by the lance.

synergy.name: Shadow Spear
synergy.description: Spirit Lance prepares surviving enemies for 6 seconds; the partner's hit chains bonus strikes through nearby enemies. Trigger with Ninja attacks or abilities.

name: Blood Moon
description: An expanding hollow ring sweeps outward, applying Bleed.

branches.name: Second Moon
branches.description: The ring contracts after expanding, enabling a second pass.

branches.name: Red Tide
branches.description: Add a second expanding ring centered on the targeted crowd.

branches.name: Moon Recoil
branches.description: The wave pushes enemies outward.

synergy.name: Eclipse Harvest
synergy.description: Blood Moon prepares surviving enemies for 6 seconds; the partner's hit triggers a status-spreading burst. Trigger with Ninja attacks or abilities.

name: Lotus Mines
description: Scatter three mines near a crowd. After arming, each bursts when an enemy approaches.

branches.name: Double Petals
branches.description: Scatter two additional mines.

branches.name: Patient Lotus
branches.description: A triggered mine rearms once for a second explosion.

branches.name: Venom Petals
branches.description: Explosions apply Poison.

synergy.name: Lotus Execution
synergy.description: Lotus Mines prepares surviving enemies for 6 seconds; the partner's hit calls down two delayed follow-up strikes. Trigger with Samurai attacks or abilities.

name: Shadow Shuriken
description: A shuriken ricochets through five distinct enemies.

branches.name: Returning Star
branches.description: After the last bounce, revisit the first target at half damage.

branches.name: Splitting Star
branches.description: Each bounce splashes nearby enemies for 30% damage.

branches.name: Toxic Star
branches.description: Bounces apply Poison.

synergy.name: Steel Ricochet
synergy.description: Shadow Shuriken prepares surviving enemies for 6 seconds; the partner's hit chains bonus strikes through nearby enemies. Trigger with Samurai attacks or abilities.

name: Smoke Lattice
description: Lay down a Poison lattice that repeatedly pushes enemies out of its center.

branches.name: Drifting Smoke
branches.description: The lattice follows active Ninja before being left behind on swap.

branches.name: Double Veil
branches.description: Create a second lattice at another nearby position.

branches.name: Choking Finale
branches.description: The last pulse deals triple damage.

synergy.name: Hidden Blade
synergy.description: Smoke Lattice prepares surviving enemies for 6 seconds; the partner's hit triggers a heavy single-target follow-up. Trigger with Samurai attacks or abilities.

name: Thunder Wire
description: Stretch a damaging wire through a nearby enemy for three pulses.

branches.name: Cross Wire
branches.description: Lay a second wire perpendicular to the first.

branches.name: Live Wire
branches.description: Wire endpoints also emit half-damage bursts.

branches.name: Venom Cable
branches.description: Wire hits apply Poison.

synergy.name: Grounded Steel
synergy.description: Thunder Wire prepares surviving enemies for 6 seconds; the partner's hit pulls nearby enemies toward the victim and damages them. Trigger with Samurai attacks or abilities.

name: Phantom Ambush
description: Two delayed phantom slashes converge on the targeted crowd.

branches.name: Third Shadow
branches.description: Add a third phantom from the opposite side.

branches.name: Lingering Shadow
branches.description: Each phantom repeats its slash at half damage.

branches.name: Assassin's Ink
branches.description: Phantom slashes apply Poison.

synergy.name: Phantom Handoff
synergy.description: Phantom Ambush prepares surviving enemies for 6 seconds; the partner's hit deals a bonus strike and reduces this family's remaining cooldown by one second. Trigger with Samurai attacks or abilities.

name: Caltrop Trail
description: Moving leaves armed caltrops behind you. Enemies stepping on them take damage and Poison.

branches.name: Forked Trail
branches.description: Leave two caltrop patches to either side.

branches.name: Persistent Spikes
branches.description: Each patch rearms once after triggering.

branches.name: Barbed Exit
branches.description: Triggered patches push enemies away.

synergy.name: Spiked Opening
synergy.description: Caltrop Trail prepares surviving enemies for 6 seconds; the partner's hit triggers a status-spreading burst. Trigger with Samurai attacks or abilities.

name: Crimson Needle
description: Target the lowest-health enemy with a focused needle; bleeding targets take 50% extra damage.

branches.name: Twin Needles
branches.description: Strike the second-lowest-health target too.

branches.name: Needle Fan
branches.description: The impact splashes nearby enemies for half damage.

branches.name: Septic Needle
branches.description: Needles apply Poison.

synergy.name: Crimson Verdict
synergy.description: Crimson Needle prepares surviving enemies for 6 seconds; the partner's hit triggers a heavy single-target follow-up. Trigger with Samurai attacks or abilities.

name: Raven Swarm
description: A raven swarm follows an enemy for six pecks, applying Poison.

branches.name: Carrion Flight
branches.description: Retarget a nearby victim when the current one dies.

branches.name: Murder of Crows
branches.description: Pecks splash nearby enemies for half damage.

branches.name: Last Cry
branches.description: The final peck emits a triple-damage burst.

synergy.name: Carrion Feast
synergy.description: Raven Swarm prepares surviving enemies for 6 seconds; the partner's hit triggers a status-spreading burst. Trigger with Samurai attacks or abilities.
